name: 艾米·道斯
introduction: Number 1 Amazon Bestselling author Amy Daws writes spicy love stories that take place in America, as well as across the pond. She’s known for her footy-playing Harris Brothers and writing in a tire shop waiting room. That waiting room experience inspired Amy to write her bestselling rom-com, Wait With Me, which was turned into a feature film on Passionflix. When Amy is not writing, she’s likely making charcuterie boards from her home in South Dakota where she lives with her daughter and husband.
